main.summary: Adapts CliWrap Command events to a ConsoleCommandObserver.

field.name: observer
field.summary: Observer that handles streamed Command events.

field.name: sync
field.summary: Synchronizes event dispatch, completion state, and callback error collection.

field.name: callbackErrors
field.summary: Errors raised by observer callbacks other than expected cancellation.

field.name: cancel
field.summary: Execution cancellation token supplied to observer callbacks.

field.name: started
field.summary: Tracked task for the started callback.

field.name: stdout
field.summary: Tracked, ordered task chain for standard output callbacks.

field.name: stderr
field.summary: Tracked, ordered task chain for standard error callbacks.

field.name: exited
field.summary: Process exit event received from CliWrap, if any.

field.name: completionStarted
field.summary: Indicates whether observer event dispatch has finished and completion is being published.

field.name: source
field.summary: TaskCompletionSource used to publish the process result and callback outcomes after dispatch completes.

property.name: Completion
property.summary: Task that completes when the observed Command finishes.

constructor.name: Constructor
constructor.param: Execution cancellation token passed to observer callbacks.

method.name: QueueCallback
method.summary: Queues a callback after the supplied task and records its outcome.
method.param: Task that must finish before this callback can run.

method.name: InvokeCallbackAsync
method.summary: Invokes an observer callback and records errors other than expected cancellation.

method.name: BeginCompletion
method.summary: Captures the tracked callbacks once event dispatch completes and starts finalization.
method.param: Error reported by the event stream, if any.

method.name: CompleteAsync
method.summary: Waits for tracked callbacks, invokes the exit callback, and publishes the completion outcome.
method.param: Error reported by the event stream, if any.

method.name: OnCompleted
method.summary: Completes event dispatch and begins waiting for the tracked observer callbacks.

method.name: OnError
method.summary: Completes event dispatch with the event-stream error and begins waiting for tracked callbacks.
method.param: Error reported by the event stream.

method.name: OnNext
method.summary: Queues the appropriate observer callback for a process event.
method.remarks: Started is ordered before stdout and stderr callbacks. Each output stream preserves its own event order, while stdout and stderr can execute concurrently. Exit events are retained for finalization.

main.summary: Contains the process result and errors collected while dispatching console observer callbacks.
main.remarks: Published after tracked Started and output callbacks have finished and OnExited has been invoked when an exit event was received.
